SL_AncientStairwell.description.english: A broad stone stairwell spiraling down into darkness. The stonework is ancient, but the steps are worn smooth by long use. Something below must be maintaining it.

SL_AncientStairwellExit.description.english: The foot of a stone stairwell spiraling up toward the surface.

SL_SanguophageLair.description.english: An ancient stone stairwell here descends into a sanguophage lair. Its occupants have kept the stairs worn smooth over the centuries, and they are unlikely to welcome daylight visitors.
